MetricReading.description:
One required metric's current state. `value` is None unless `state == available`; an
unavailable or never-fetched metric is `null` on the wire, never 0 and never NaN.
MetricReading.title: MetricReading

UpdateSettingsRequest.description:
Only the kill switch is mutable at runtime. `real_send_enabled` and `autonomy_mode` are
deliberately absent (extra fields are rejected): enabling real send needs an approved
live_send_activation (ADR-0007) and is not available in this build.
UpdateSettingsRequest.title: UpdateSettingsRequest

post.description:
Starts the campaign: the same guarded DRAFT/PAUSED -> ACTIVE transition as `activate`.
It enqueues no work and sends nothing; automation stays behind the policy gate.

get.description:
Why the prospect is where it is: the qualification decision (with DEFERRED reason and
`missing_metrics`), each required metric's state, ranking, dossier, evidence, contacts.
